contributions.anchor: BOX B 'Contributions Received this Period' (9396.50) on the SUMMARY PAGE, which on this modern_boxAF filing is the LAST page (p4, located by its printed heading 'Summary Page'); the same 9396.50 is Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page' AND its 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)', and it is repeated in Box F 'Subtotal before Expenditures (Box A + Box B)' because Box A is zero
contributions.detail: 13 Schedule A rows sum to 100 + 500 + 250 + 100 + 1000 + 275 + 1000 + 200 + 50 + (-328.50) + 2000 + 2000 + 2250 = 9,396.50 exactly = the schedule's printed page subtotal = its printed total = Box B. THE SUM INCLUDES ONE NEGATIVE ROW: 'Costco Reimbursment' -328.50, printed with a leading minus sign, and the side closes only with the sign preserved (as a positive it would give 10,053.50). Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints the SAME 9396.50 because this is the filer's first report of the cycle, so period equals year-to-date and no cumulative/period distinction arises; Box C is never summed as an increment regardless. The ladder corroborates: Box A 0 + Box B 9396.50 = Box F 9396.50, minus Box D 9266.96 = the balance-at-close box 129.54 exactly as printed.

THE MODERN v.4.20 SCHEDULE B HAS A REAL 'Purpose' COLUMN of its own (headings: Date / Provider/Vendor / Purpose / Amount) - the first Utah County variant in this wave that does, since every legacy_colAB blank 2008-2018 prints no purpose column at all. So `purpose` here is a printed field, not a workaround.

compare Schedule A row 10, a -328.50 'Costco Reimbursment' - the filer books the refund as a negative contribution rather than reducing this expenditure. Transcribed as the document reports it; no netting.

THE DATE IS AFTER THE REPORT ITSELF: the report is signed and stamped 6/23/20 but this row is dated 6-30-20. Kept VERBATIM - a date that is well-formed but outside its own reporting period is a fact about the document and is never corrected (CHUNK_BRIEF section 7). The amount is inside the filer's own subtotal, so the side still closes.

notes: Andrea Allen, Utah County RECORDER, 2020 cycle - and THIS IS THE FIRST modern_boxAF FILING OF THE WAVE, so the form is characterised here in full. index.csv names 'Andrea Allen' and the page face agrees. Report type: 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election' (radio button filled), amendment = No (radio filled), report date 6/23/20, clerk stamp '20 JUN 23 PM 3:47. Single report, no bundle. ===== FORM CHARACTERISATION (v. 4.20, printed in the page footer) ===== The blank is a BORN-DIGITAL FILLABLE PDF issued by the Elections Division under Clerk/Auditor Amelia Powers Gardner, printed, signed and re-scanned; every figure is machine-set type, unlike the handwritten legacy era. FOUR pages: p1 cover / p2 Schedule A / p3 Schedule B / **p4 SUMMARY PAGE, which is the LAST page** - the opposite position from the legacy blank and exactly as the module's variant table predicts for modern_boxAF, but located here BY ITS PRINTED HEADING 'Summary Page', never by ordinal. NO CHECKLIST DECOY page is present in this filing. The summary boxes are lettered A (Balance at Beginning) / B (Contributions this Period) / C (Contributions Year to Date) / D (Expenditures this Period) / E (Expenditures Year to Date) / F (Subtotal before Expenditures = Box A + Box B), and the final box, 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)', is **UNLETTERED on this revision** - it is not lettered G. Box A is a typed '0', a numeral and not a nil mark, so it reads 0 under the zero-glyph ruling. THE SCHEDULES ARE FULLY BOXED GRIDS of 15 rows each, with the column headings printed in little tabs above the grid: Schedule A is 'Date / Name of Contributor / Address and Zip Code / Amount'; SCHEDULE B IS 'Date / Provider/Vendor / PURPOSE / Amount' - a REAL PURPOSE COLUMN, which no legacy_colAB blank in this corpus has, and 'Provider/Vendor' is the ADDENDUM H5 vocabulary now seen on the modern form. Each schedule prints TWO footers with DIFFERENT SCOPES - 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total ... (Sum of all Schedule A/B pages in this report)' - and on a one-page schedule they are equal; each page also repeats a small Name of Candidate / Date of Report / Page box at the foot, and THE 'Page' FIELD IS LEFT BLANK ON EVERY PAGE of this filing, so there is no foliation at all here. REDACTION: this file is doubly named '_Redacted_Redacted' and the county blacked out the candidate's SIGNATURE on the cover and the STREET portion of every donor address on Schedule A, leaving city/state/ZIP legible - except on Schedule A row 10 where the bar also covers the city. The bars are the document; nothing was reconstructed. Both sides reconcile EXACTLY on the promoted per-period boxes B and D.
